meta.name: iron-proxy-gateway
meta.description: Use Iron Proxy for external accounts and APIs, including GitHub through gh. Connect credentials through the operator console and diagnose blocked requests without exposing tokens or adding unnecessary MCP servers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让外部账号和接口调用都走代理,排查被拦截的请求,不用暴露密钥
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 想让程序安全访问 GitHub 等外部账号,又不想把令牌暴露出去
copy.tagline_en: Route API calls through a proxy, trace blocked requests, keep tokens hidden
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your programs need external accounts like GitHub without exposing tokens

howto.what: 连接外部账号和 API(如用 gh 访问 GitHub)时,Claude 会让请求走 Iron Proxy,通过操作台转交凭据、等待人工审批,并诊断被拦截的请求;全程只用占位符,不打印或索要真实 token。
howto.when: 当你需要用外部账号或 API、拿到的 403/401 需要定位是哪一层拦截,或要发起账号连接时触发;连接结果由操作台转交,命令本身不改策略。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 账号通过 Iron Proxy 连上
say.note: 会返回 connect_url 并说明它的 action

say.text: 我请求被 403 拦了,看看是哪一层拒绝的
say.note: 会报告主机名和错误,请运维侧检查

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude sends outbound HTTP/HTTPS through Iron Proxy: account setup is handed off to the operator console, credential requests wait for human approval, and blocked requests get diagnosed. Only placeholders are used; no real tokens are printed or stored.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need an external account or API (such as GitHub via gh), when a 403/401 needs to be traced to the layer that rejected it, or when starting an account connection.

say_en.text: Connect my GitHub account through Iron Proxy
say_en.note: Returns the connect_url and its action

say_en.text: My request got a 403 — find which layer blocked it
say_en.note: Reports hostname and error, asks for a host-side check

say_en.text: Use gateway-managed as the GH_TOKEN placeholder, not a real token
say_en.note: Keeps real credentials out of the client
